left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Must have a clinical diagnosis of solid tumor cancer and be seeking treatment  [AND] and supportive care at the UF Health Cancer Center (Medical Plaza)
  -  Patients must plan to receive chemotherapy known to be associated with the need for supportive care within 30 days of enrollment
  -  Life expectancy must be greater than 6 months
  -  Must have Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0-2
  -  Written informed consent obtained from the patient
  -  The ability for the patient to comply with all the study-related procedures

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients unwilling or unable to provide voluntary informed consent
  -  Patients who are unwilling or unable to comply with protocol requirement and/or follow-up procedures
  -  Patients planned to undergo cancer therapy other than chemotherapy (i

left.raw_text:
, radiation, [OR]  surgery  [OR] or hormonal treatment alone)
  -  Prisoners  [OR] or patients who are involuntarily incarcerated

right.raw_text: Patients who are compulsorily detained for treatment of either a psychiatric  [OR] or physical illness
